OOP Scenario 01

The Animal Kingdom

Understanding Inheritance & Polymorphism

Concept: Inheritance

Inheritance allows a new class (Child) to adopt the attributes and methods of an existing class (Parent). This avoids code duplication. We can then use Polymorphism (overriding) to change specific behaviors in the Child class.

Class Structure

The "We Do" Task

Step-by-Step Instructions

  1. Download the starter file below.
  2. Look at the Animal class. It has a generic speak() method.
  3. Create a class Dog that inherits from Animal:
    class Dog(Animal):
  4. Define speak(self) inside Dog to return "Woof!".
  5. Repeat for Cat, making it return "Meow!".
  6. Polymorphism Check: Create a list called zoo with both animals, loop through it, and print animal.speak(). Notice how the same method call produces different results!
